def transform(grid):
    """Turn the sparse color into the original background color; clear background."""
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    foreground = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    return [[background if v == foreground else 0 for v in row] for row in grid]
